notes.title: The "KUUKIYOMI" Series: "8 YOUs+" Release Announced & "Jump,YOU!+" Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]The mini-game [i]8 YOUs[/i] in [i]KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It[/i] gets an upgrade![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37023485/526234e6b092f89566132213656f98fe9c30469f.jpg[/img]
[h3]You are trapped on a train that runs forever. 
What's worse, the train is filled with countless versions of YOU, all looking exactly like YOU... 
Pay close attention and find the one different YOU among the eight, then make your way to the last car and reach the exit![/h3]

This is an enhanced version of the [i]8 YOUs[/i] mini-game included in [i]KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It[/i]. It now supports multiplayer and features score rankings, offering even more exciting gameplay.

[h3]What's New in [i]"8 YOUs+"[/i]?[/h3]

[list]
[*] [i]"Two Player" Mode![/i]

You can race alongside another player to compete for the fastest escape!
[/list]
[list]
[*] [i]Score Rankings![/i]

Score rankings are now available for each stage.
Challenge '8 YOUs' players from around the world based on your scores!
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Collection![/b]

There are 88 different versions of YOU. 
You can add the successfully identified YOU to your 'Collection' with the criticize action!
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]New Stages![/b]

There are 3 stages in total.
Under certain conditions, 2 additional stages will unlock...!
[/list]

The Steam version of [i]8 YOUs+[/i] is set to launch on [i]March 13th.[/i]
Be sure to add it to your wishlist and get ready to play!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399580

notes.title: The "KUUKIYOMI" Series: "Jump,YOU!+" Release Announced & "YOU Game+" Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]The mini-game [i]Jump YOU[/i] in [i]KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It[/i] gets an upgrade![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37023485/fcbe763351679923a053f80cf5c769aa09d54e87.jpg[/img]
[h3]As a lost stray cat, you tirelessly jump toward the top to return to your owner![/h3]

This is an enhanced version of the [i]Jump YOU[/i] mini-game included in [i]KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It[/i]. It now supports multiplayer and features score rankings, offering even more exciting gameplay.

[h3]What's New in [i]"Jump,YOU!+"[/i]?[/h3]

[list]
[*] [i]"Two Player" Mode![/i]

The two of you, connected by a rope, will work together to reach the top.
If one of you slips, the other can pull them back up!
Team up with friends or family and climb together as a pair!
[/list]
[list]
[*] [i]Score Rankings![/i]

Compete with players worldwide to achieve the highest score in each game mode.
Try to top the leaderboard in both the "One Player" and "Two Player" rankings!
[/list]
[list]
[*] [i]New Stage![/i]

The stage layout from the middle stages onward in KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It's "Jump YOU" has been partially revamped!
Even if you’ve cleared the previous game, challenge yourself with the new stages!
[/list]


The Steam version of [i]Jump,YOU!+[/i] is set to launch on [i]February 27th.[/i]
Be sure to add it to your wishlist and get ready to play!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399590

notes.title: Series Spin-off "YOU Game+" Release Confirmed!
notes.content:
[h2]The [i]YOU Game[/i] from [i]KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It[/i] is back, now with a "+" (plus) for even more fun![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37023485/c7c39e7cb32f9152f491a0a87ae8cedb456fdb2c.jpg[/img]
[h3]Let’s combine "YOU" and "YOU" to create a BIG "YOU"![/h3]

This is an enhanced version of the [i]YOU Game[/i] mini-game included in [i]KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It[/i]. It now supports multiplayer and features score rankings, offering even more exciting gameplay.

[h3]What's New in [i]"YOU Game+"[/i]?[/h3]

[list]
[*] [i]"Two Player" Mode![/i]

In this mode, you and a friend take turns dropping "YOU"s into the same box.
Work together to get the highest score possible!
[/list]
[list]
[*] [i]Score Rankings![/i]

Compete with players worldwide to achieve the highest score in each game mode.
Try to top the leaderboard in both the "One Player" and "Two Player" rankings!
[/list]
[list]
[*] [i]Skin System![/i]

As you progress through the game, you'll unlock skins that change the appearance of "YOU".
Three different skins are included, and you’ll have to play to find out what skins are available and how to unlock them!
[/list]


The Steam version of [i]YOU Game+[/i] is set to launch on [i]February 13th.[/i]
Be sure to add it to your wishlist and get ready to play!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399570/

notes.title: “KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It” is now available!
notes.content:
Today, we have started distributing the new work "KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229715/142498357d5f2e3f6e4f888d88103e9577342d6c.jpg[/img]


This work also puts a spotlight on the childhood of the main character, "YOU", and lets you innocently read the atmosphere while looking back on various events that anyone would have experienced as a child.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229715/d806e551972c5b1151aac7d788832485dd2d46fb.jpg[/img]


In the "Consider It" mode, there are 100 completely new questions!
After playing all the questions, your "ability to read the atmosphere" will be diagnosed.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229715/523458c6681f37bfa9ed5e5c6a25f81598209d71.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229715/6c7c0d6aaa8f34ddb57f5abf5921510f07463386.jpg[/img]


This game is also packed with content, including a "Consider It Together" mode that allows you to diagnose the compatibility of two people, and a "Fun Minigames" mode that includes three mini-games that everyone will surely love!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229715/bb07073abbadebfa77e67784312e39a57deaae20.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229715/e151006a9c7f49d7c4aafd737e61a7f158a9b7a5.jpg[/img]



To commemorate the release of this title, we are holding a launch sale where you can buy it at 30% off!
Please take this opportunity to buy!

Also, be sure to register and follow us on our wishlist to receive information about the release of "KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It"!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3140130/
